# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/api_reference.py from contracts/http; do not edit. -->

Every HTTP route and MCP tool of Veyndo, per component, generated from the same contracts as the [SDKs](../sdks.md). Contract set 1.0.0. Each operation shows its permission, its owning source file and a copyable call in curl, TypeScript, Python and Rust.

## Try it from this page

Public reads have a **Try it** panel. It calls the shop you enter below directly from your browser, with no credential. The server admits exactly 11 anonymous reads from other origins ([`contracts/browser-reads.json`](../../contracts/browser-reads.json)); everything else shows the request instead:

- **Writes** are never executed from the docs. Use a [private sandbox](../build-your-first-app.md#deploy-to-a-private-sandbox).
- **Merchant reads** need your credential; the docs never ask for it.
- **MCP tools** accept browser calls only from the shop’s own origin, so their panels show the JSON-RPC request to copy.

<div class="docs-try-config"></div>

## Authentication

| Credential | Header | Get it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| None (public) | `x-tenant: <shop id>` | The shop ID from Studio or your sandbox |
| Personal session | `authorization: Bearer <token>` | `POST /api/auth/login` or `/api/auth/register` |
| Integration key | `authorization: Bearer <key>` | **Developer → API & integrations**, server-side only |

## Errors

Every failure is `{"errors":[Problem, …]}` on HTTP and inside `structuredContent.errors` of an MCP result with `isError: true`. The SDKs raise both as one error type.

| Problem field | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `kind` | yes |
| `retryable` | yes |
| `scope` | no |
| `pointer` | no |
| `currentRevision` | no |
| `code` | yes |
| `status` | yes |
| `detail` | yes |

Kinds: `validation_error`, `authentication_required`, `permission_denied`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `quota_exceeded`, `rate_limited`, `temporarily_unavailable`, `provider_unavailable`, `internal_error`, `revision_conflict`, `output_contract_error`.
